reviews.review:
This game is a lot of thing, but not one of them is positive.
Even if it is cheap, it's just not worth it.

Game starts with a message saying: "was made by many people around the world"
Title screen credits say: "is the work of a single developer"

???

I have a few things to say about the game but I'll start off with the positive.
The overall fighting against zombies in semi revealing outfits is always nice and fun and having the clothes rip is always a nice touch as well. I like that in games like this and enjoy different outfits as well. The plot is okay and isn't complicated to understand which is a plus as well. I like how she can climb in the game on almost anything as well. I know this game still looks like it's still in development along the way. This game does have some potential in my eyes to be better than what it looks and what other reviews say about it.

What I have to say about what needs work on in my opinion are fighting and dialogue options and some atmospheric music to go along with the maps. The fighting aspect of it is the dodging and when you're aiming suddenly stops when enemies are close to you like zombies and when you're in front of a wall. This sometimes gets annoying because when I am aiming at a zombie or those big foot like creatures the aiming stops and I have to use my melee or try to squeeze through them to run away to aim again.

The dodging only works when you jump and I don't understand what that does for the character. To be honest having to dodge enemy attacks is a much better way for the mechanic then just jumping and rolling.

The character needs a name as well and more of a backstory of how she joined this what looks like some organization of some type. There are NPC's but they don't talk and you can't interact with them. Having some information and even a name for the character would give her some life and some character development to start. Some more facial expressions in the model would be way better for her to not look so much like a doll that just moves around. Some cut scenes of her talking and blinking would also make her seem less like a doll with a gun.

The game needs more choices for the mouse and keyboard key bindings as well. I couldn't bind any of the keys to my mouse buttons on the side and it was a bit disappointing to not have that function. You should be able to reload while running as well because when you're in a firefight and have to run away to reload you're unable to reload while running and also at times your character gets stuck on things in the ground instead of being able to walk over them normally and that can be frustrating when you're moving around an enclosed place while shooting. The map for the hospital is a great example showing this. All them chairs and other things on the floor stop you from moving around when you're walking or running over them.

Those are the more major issues with the game in my opinion.
I can say the jiggle physics are nice and and the outfit choices could have more rips in them when being attacked and more clothing variety. I hope to see more outfits and weapon choices as well. I think having melee weapons able to have an executable function for zombies would be nice and more blood and more wounds being shown on the character whenever she is attacked or hit would make it more real so to say.
That's all I have to say about the game so far. I see potential with the game and hope to see it get more attention.

I feel like I was swindled. I was fully expecting a nsfw experience and buddy, my drawer full of hanes and tank tops is more risque. I am in no way expecting a top of the line experience but this game is just plain ugly. Everything seems out of focus, especially the female character. The lighting is a mess, it's either too dark or too bright with little dynamic nuances. I wouldn't buy if I were you.
